invariants.rationale: clusteringGroup is used to retrieve slices, suggesting it must be non-null.
strategyParams is passed to downstream methods, so it is expected to be non-null.
instantTime is used to read records and pass to other methods, so it should not be null.
Clustering instant time is usually required to be a valid, non-empty string.
The number of output groups for clustering should be positive for meaningful clustering.
